# Corpus

The corpus says what the words mean in this Space. It has one entry per concept. Read an entry when you meet its word in the Lore, on the GitHub Project or in the conversation. Each entry says what the term means, where the thing it names is kept, and which verbs and processes act on it.

The Space's own entries are files in this folder, beside the folder below, and each has a line here. The verb corpus-add writes a new entry.

- [core/](./core/index.md): the entries for the terms that AI-Lore itself defines, with the same meaning in every Space.
